item.title: Parliament calls for withdrawal of policy directive paving way for Starlink's entry into SA
item.description: Solly Malatsi, Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies, last week issued a formal policy direction to the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa (Icasa), instructing it to urgently align its ownership regulations with the amended ICT Sector Code under the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) framework.

item.title: Racist harassment in healthcare: A nurse's ordeal in Cape Town
item.description: A man who became impatient in an emergency room as he did not receive immediate treatment, was found guilty of committing hate speech after he swore at a nurse on duty.

item.title: Still no justice for brave Omotoso whistleblower Pamela Mabini
item.description: Pamela Mabini, a prominent gender-based violence (GBV) and community activist was gunned down outside her home in Gqeberha on March 7, 2025.

item.title: Bondi Beach terror attack: Shooters identified as Pakistani-origin father-son duo
item.description: The shooters have been identified as a Pakistani-origin father-son duo. Naveed Akram, 24, was wounded and is currently undergoing treatment at a hospital. His father Sajid Akram was killed.

item.title: Sangoma, 80, shot dead at his home by man purporting to be a police detective
item.description: Limpopo police have launched a manhunt after an 80-year-old traditional healer was shot dead at his home in Nwa-Khuwani village near Giyani.

item.title: TNPA signs R1.4bn Durban LPG Terminal deal to boost gas supply
item.description: Transnet National Ports Authority (TNPA) signed a landmark, R1.4 billion, 25-year agreement with WASAA CEF SOC Ltd to develop and operate a new liquefied petroleum gas terminal at the Port of Durban’s Island View Precinct on Friday.

item.title: Lost for years, found miles away: microchipped dog reunites with owner after cross-country journey
item.description: Patricia Orozco with her dog Choco, nearly five years after Choco disappeared from her home in May 2021.

item.title: DStv blackout looms as 16 channels face New Year’s axe amid standoff with Warner Bros
item.description: The countdown to 2026 has become a countdown to a blackout as millions of South African households are staring down the barrel of a New Year's Eve deadline that could see 12 of the country’s most popular channels vanish from their screens at the stroke of midnight.

item.title: Constitution wins in Western Cape housing battle
item.description: The Western Cape High Court interdicted liquidators from selling or disposing of 41 properties forming part of the Olive Close housing project in Melkbosstrand. (Indicative photo.)
